name: ^transport\.(addReaction|startTyping)$
reason: The Telegram SDK performs the Bot API call; the twin compares the thread, message and emoji it is given.

name: ^discord\.(addReaction|decodeThreadId|encodeThreadId|postMessage|startTyping)$
reason: The Chat SDK Discord adapter encodes thread ids and performs the REST call; the twin compares what it is given.

name: ^github\.addReaction$
reason: The Chat SDK GitHub adapter verifies the HMAC and calls the REST API; the twin compares what it is given.

name: ^transport\.encodeThreadId$
reason: The Chat SDK adapter encodes a provider thread id; the twin compares the parts it is given.

name: ^webhooks\.verify$
reason: The Linear SDK checks the HMAC and timestamp window; the twin treats a throw as a failed check.

name: ^createHmac\("sha256", options\.appSecret\) \.update(\(req\.body, "utf8"\) \.digest)?$
reason: Node crypto absorbs the exact webhook body and returns the standard SHA-256 digest; the twin compares the secret, body and encoding it is given.

name: ^tokenValidator\(options\.appId\)\.validateAccessToken$
reason: The Bot Framework JWT validator checks the token against Microsoft's keys; the twin treats an empty claim set as a failed check.

name: ^transport\.handleWebhook$
reason: The Chat SDK Google Chat adapter verifies the signed token and answers with a status; the twin reads only the status.

name: ^verifyTwilioRequest$
reason: The Twilio SDK checks the request signature against the auth token; the twin treats its own verification error as a failed check.

name: ^(assertSlackOk|callSlackApi)$
reason: The Chat SDK Slack API client performs the Web API call; the twin compares the method and parameters and treats a not-ok answer as the SDK's error.

name: ^(parseSlackWebhookBody|verifySlackSignature)$
reason: The Chat SDK Slack webhook helpers decode the body and check the HMAC; the twin branches on the kind they return and treats a throw as a failed check.

name: ^formatter\.toResponseUrlText$
reason: The Chat SDK Slack formatter renders markdown for a response URL; the twin compares its input and forwards its text.

name: ^(Card|Image)$
reason: Chat SDK card element constructors; the twin compares the fields it hands them and passes the element on.
